::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-8 .about-text}
[Stefan Langenbach]{.founder-name}

With over 10 years of experience in data engineering, machine learning and cloud architecture, Stefan founded byteCare to help businesses adopt AI that respects privacy and stays under their control — using lean, performant models hosted in Europe.

Our mission is to make AI accessible, transparent and privacy-preserving. We believe every business deserves AI solutions that are cost-effective, performant and fully GDPR-compliant — without the risks, complexity or cost of big tech. With byteCare, you get direct expertise and solutions you can trust.
:::
